component.name: ARSS
component.summary: Accessible RSS, podcast and programme reader
Přístupná čtečka RSS, podcastů a programu

description.p: ARSS reads RSS and Atom feeds, plays podcasts and shows Czech television and radio schedules using a keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible GTK 4 interface.
ARSS čte RSS a Atom kanály, přehrává podcasty a zobrazuje český televizní a rozhlasový program v rozhraní GTK 4 přístupném z klávesnice i čtečky obrazovky.
Uses the verified cross-platform ARSS Contract for stable station IDs, a broader offline guide catalogue, safe legacy preference migration, and shared parser golden tests.
Removes bundled notification audio, delegates audible feedback to GNOME, and releases the clean Linux source under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Keeps the GNOME application launcher valid while an RPM upgrade replaces ARSS's command-line launcher.
Completes the Linux accessibility guide audit by naming custom menus, reflowing the interface at 200% text, and preserving focused full-text main tabs.
Adds Nova Sport 3 through 6 from the verified SMS.cz programme source, with clean display names and stable provider identifiers.
Groups television stations by broadcaster with accessible native search, preserves station IDs when opening programmes, and moves subscription actions into named RSS and podcast menus.
Removes an ambiguously announced switch mnemonic while preserving native keyboard and screen-reader operation.
Adds accessible podcast volume, keeps playback running across focus changes, and makes standalone programme and empty-list text keyboard-readable.
Restores native arrow-key navigation in content lists without duplicate focus stops.
Completes Android 1.6.4 feature parity, accessibility fixes and native GNOME desktop integration.
